instruction: A candid cinematic medium shot captures an indoor office setting next to a large window. On the left, the woman in the white shirt and glasses (R1) stands facing right, looking down intently at an open notebook held in both hands. On the right, the woman in the dark vest (R2) stands in profile facing left, holding a dark mug and listening. The two women stand close together, sharing a quiet moment of focus over the notebook. Soft, natural daylight diffuses from the window, casting gentle shadows and highlighting the warm brick wall on the far left.
